Class Browsing

java.lang.Object
org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.playwright.Browsing
public final class Browsing extends Object
Runs code that drives a browser against a Server of the harness, in the trace of the server: the code runs in a span, each step is a child span, and every request the browser sends to the server carries the current span, so the server's spans are children of the step that caused them. 
Harness.inServer("Library", routes -> ..., server -> Browsing.inBrowser(server, session -> {
    session.step("Open the catalog", () -> session.page().navigate("/"));
    session.step("Search", () -> session.page().getByLabel("Title").fill("Dune"));
    return null;
}));
Screenshots, those steps take and those taken with Session.screenshot(String), are written to a directory and reported as log records in the span they were taken in, with the file's path as an attribute: a recorded trace says what the page looked like at each step. The browser's console messages and page errors are log records too.

The trace context is added to requests to the server only, never to requests to other origins, such as content delivery networks, which have no use for it.
